title: Internships at Max Planck Institutes in Computer Science
institution: Max Planck Institutes in Computer Science (MPI-INF, MPI-SWS, MPI-SP)
about: Research internships across computer science at the Max Planck Institutes for Informatics, Software Systems, and Security and Privacy. For summer 2027 starts (May to August), applications are due by 1 November 2026; successful applicants hear before 1 February.
requirements: Exceptional bachelor, master and doctoral students worldwide, and exceptional individuals from industry
For summer starts (May to August) the strict deadline is 1 November of the previous year
Successful applicants hear back before 1 February

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Computer science research" (record skill) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Exceptional bachelor, master and doctoral students" (qualification) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
